summary: Retested offline-first migration fixes from iteration 3. All three review scenarios now pass on the preview URL. (1) Fresh IndexedDB → migration pulls 4 notes from /api/notes and shows 'Restored 4 notes from server' success toast + 4 notes render. (2) Reload after migration → NO 'Restored 0 notes' toast (previously spurious due to StrictMode double-run). (3) Manual 'Recover Old Notes from Server' with everything already present → shows info toast 'No additional notes to restore' instead of misleading 'Restored 0 notes and 0 templates' success. Migration flag set atomically before await IO, and toasts are gated on count > 0.

issues: Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on Settings modal (accessibility a11y warning, non-blocking).

passed_tests: Phase 1 - Fresh migration: after indexedDB.deleteDatabase('IronRabbit') + reload, 4 notes rendered (Test #4, Test Backend Note, Test Reminder Note, Test Note), success toast 'Restored 4 notes from server' visible, metadataStore.migrated_from_backend = True
Phase 2 - No duplicate toast: reload after migration shows 0 toasts and no 'Restored' text; 4 notes still rendered from local IndexedDB

Phase 3 - Manual restore idempotent + correct UX: clicking [data-testid='restore-server-btn'] with all notes already local shows 'Checking server for your notes...' then 'No additional notes to restore' (info toast). No 'Restored 0 notes and 0 templates' toast.
Route /apps/iron-rabbit-notes/launch loads NotesApp correctly after site refactor
StrictMode race resolved: metadataStore flag is set BEFORE the fetch/await IO in migrateFromBackend so the second concurrent StrictMode invocation short-circuits
action_items: (Optional / minor) Add aria-describedby or <DialogDescription> to Settings DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: storageService.migrateFromBackend now sets the migrated flag before await IO for non-force calls — this correctly prevents StrictMode double-runs from both proceeding to write.
handleRestoreFromServer correctly gates the success toast on (result.notes > 0 || result.templates > 0) and falls through to the info toast otherwise.
fetchData also correctly gates its success toast on migration.notes > 0.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 4 backend notes at /api/notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notes app is at /apps/iron-rabbit-notes/launch. Backend /api/notes returns 4 test notes. To reset local storage use page.evaluate with indexedDB.deleteDatabase('IronRabbit') then reload. Restore-from-server button is [data-testid='restore-server-btn'] inside Settings modal.
rca of the issue: Original bug: user's notes disappeared after refactor to offline-first because frontend stopped reading from backend. Fix in iteration 3 (verified in iteration 4): (a) storageService.migrateFromBackend fetches from /api/notes on first load and writes to IndexedDB, then sets migrated_from_backend flag; (b) flag is set BEFORE the await fetch to make it StrictMode-safe (idempotent); (c) success toast in fetchData is gated on migration.notes > 0 so no 'Restored 0 notes' appears; (d) manual restore branches on notes+templates > 0 to distinguish 'restored X' vs 'no additional to restore'. All fixes verified working via Playwright on preview URL.
